title: Rohan Chakkadath
text:
What I Do: I love solving problems, domain irrespective. Thats what got me into computers in the first place. With a graduation focused in Computer Science and Engineering, I have over 6+ years managing entriprise deployments across Asia, the Middel east and Africa. I also have an independent fitness product suite venture, on the side. Because, I love lifting weights.
Why MDS: I was always fascinated by the idea that solving problems make learning easier. I love working with data and solving data problems and here I am, sitting down a diverse cohort of 35+ nationalities.
Outside of MDS: I like lifting big weights and listing to alot of questionable music.
